WITH da_ingredients AS (
  SELECT v.concept_id
  FROM (VALUES (720810),(713823),(786426),(837027),(730548),(1558471)) v(concept_id)
),
da_drugs AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT descendant_concept_id AS drug_concept_id
  FROM omop.concept_ancestor
  WHERE ancestor_concept_id IN (SELECT concept_id FROM da_ingredients)
),
pd_concepts AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT descendant_concept_id AS condition_concept_id
  FROM omop.concept_ancestor
  WHERE ancestor_concept_id = 381270
),
first_da AS (
  SELECT de.person_id, MIN(de.drug_exposure_start_date) AS index_date
  FROM omop.drug_exposure de
  JOIN da_drugs d ON d.drug_concept_id = de.drug_concept_id
  GROUP BY de.person_id
),
pd_starters AS (
  SELECT f.person_id, f.index_date
  FROM first_da f
  WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM omop.condition_occurrence co
    JOIN pd_concepts pc ON pc.condition_concept_id = co.condition_concept_id
    WHERE co.person_id = f.person_id AND co.condition_start_date <= f.index_date
  )
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS parkinson_patients_starting_dopamine_agonist
FROM pd_starters;

WITH da_ingredients AS (
  SELECT v.concept_id
  FROM (VALUES (720810),(713823),(786426),(837027),(730548),(1558471),(732309),(19134000),(19091472)) v(concept_id)
),
da_drugs AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT descendant_concept_id AS drug_concept_id
  FROM omop.concept_ancestor
  WHERE ancestor_concept_id IN (SELECT concept_id FROM da_ingredients)
),
pd_concepts AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT descendant_concept_id AS condition_concept_id
  FROM omop.concept_ancestor
  WHERE ancestor_concept_id = 381270
),
first_da AS (
  SELECT de.person_id, MIN(de.drug_exposure_start_date) AS index_date
  FROM omop.drug_exposure de
  JOIN da_drugs d ON d.drug_concept_id = de.drug_concept_id
  GROUP BY de.person_id
),
pd_starters AS (
  SELECT f.person_id, f.index_date
  FROM first_da f
  WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM omop.condition_occurrence co
    JOIN pd_concepts pc ON pc.condition_concept_id = co.condition_concept_id
    WHERE co.person_id = f.person_id
      AND co.condition_start_date <= f.index_date
  )
),
side_effect_roots AS (
  SELECT * FROM (VALUES
    ('Nausea/vomiting', 31967),
    ('Nausea/vomiting', 27674),
    ('Nausea/vomiting', 441408),
    ('Dizziness', 4223938),
    ('Dizziness', 433316),
    ('Dizziness', 4198449),
    ('Orthostatic hypotension', 319041),
    ('Orthostatic hypotension', 36713737),
    ('Syncope', 135360),
    ('Somnolence/sleep attack', 4108537),
    ('Somnolence/sleep attack', 4141828),
    ('Somnolence/sleep attack', 4158978),
    ('Hallucinations/psychosis', 433031),
    ('Hallucinations/psychosis', 4275889),
    ('Hallucinations/psychosis', 436073),
    ('Hallucinations/psychosis', 444401),
    ('Confusion', 381273),
    ('Dyskinesia', 4319906),
    ('Edema/peripheral edema', 433595),
    ('Edema/peripheral edema', 4158343),
    ('Impulse-control disorders', 433752),
    ('Impulse-control disorders', 4053320),
    ('Impulse-control disorders', 4092385),
    ('Impulse-control disorders', 436959),
    ('Impulse-control disorders', 4252239),
    ('Constipation', 75860),
    ('Headache', 378253)
  ) AS v(side_effect, root_concept_id)
),
side_effect_concepts AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT r.side_effect, ca.descendant_concept_id AS condition_concept_id
  FROM side_effect_roots r
  JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca ON ca.ancestor_concept_id = r.root_concept_id
),
hits AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT s.side_effect, p.person_id
  FROM pd_starters p
  JOIN omop.condition_occurrence co
    ON co.person_id = p.person_id
   AND co.condition_start_date >= p.index_date
   AND co.condition_start_date < DATEADD(day, 184, p.index_date)
  JOIN side_effect_concepts s ON s.condition_concept_id = co.condition_concept_id
),
den AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM pd_starters)
SELECT h.side_effect,
       COUNT(DISTINCT h.person_id) AS patients_with_event,
       d.n AS cohort_n,
       CAST(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT h.person_id) / d.n AS DECIMAL(6,2)) AS pct_within_6mo
FROM hits h
CROSS JOIN den d
GROUP BY h.side_effect, d.n
ORDER BY patients_with_event DESC, h.side_effect;

In our OMOP cohort, using first dopamine-agonist prescription as index among Parkinson’s patients:

`N = 1,513` Parkinson’s patients starting a dopamine agonist.

Side effects within 6 months, ranked by frequency:

| Side effect group | Patients | % of cohort |
|---|---:|---:|
| Constipation | 106 | 7.01% |
| Dyskinesia | 62 | 4.10% |
| Edema / peripheral edema | 56 | 3.70% |
| Orthostatic hypotension | 50 | 3.30% |
| Hallucinations / psychosis | 41 | 2.71% |
| Headache | 40 | 2.64% |
| Dizziness | 25 | 1.65% |

So, in this cohort the most commonly recorded post-prescription side effects were **constipation**, **dyskinesia**, **edema/peripheral edema**, and **orthostatic hypotension**.

Method note: I counted diagnosis records in `condition_occurrence` occurring from index date through 183 days after first dopamine-agonist exposure. Dopamine agonists included pramipexole, ropinirole, rotigotine, apomorphine, bromocriptine, cabergoline, pergolide, piribedil, and lisuride via OMOP descendants.
